name: P23.OneTie.isDirectionalCentre_x_iff
statement:
theorem isDirectionalCentre_x_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (centre : Normal a b c) :
    IsDirectionalCentre S .x centre ↔
      centre ∈ S ∧ ∀ s ∈ S,
        (∀ _hx : 0 < s.x,
          s.y ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z ≤ centre.z ∧
            (s.x - 1 ≤ centre.x ∨
              (s.y + b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z + c ≤ centre.z))) ∧
        (∀ _hsx : s.x = 0, ∀ _hy : b ≤ s.y, ∀ _hz : c ≤ s.z,
          s.y - b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z - c ≤ centre.z ∧
            (a - 1 ≤ centre.x ∨
              (s.y - b + b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z - c + c ≤ centre.z)))

name: P23.OneTie.isDirectionalCentre_y_iff
statement:
theorem isDirectionalCentre_y_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (centre : Normal a b c) :
    IsDirectionalCentre S .y centre ↔
      centre ∈ S ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ _hy : 0 < s.y,
        s.y - 1 ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z ≤ centre.z ∧
          (s.x ≤ centre.x ∨
            (s.y - 1 + b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z + c ≤ centre.z))

name: P23.OneTie.isDirectionalCentre_z_iff
statement:
theorem isDirectionalCentre_z_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))

    IsDirectionalCentre S .z centre ↔
      centre ∈ S ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ _hz : 0 < s.z,
        s.y ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z - 1 ≤ centre.z ∧
          (s.x ≤ centre.x ∨
            (s.y + b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z - 1 + c ≤ centre.z))

name: P23.OneTie.h4_x_edge_ordinary_exact
statement:
theorem h4_x_edge_ordinary_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    {C R : Normal a b c} (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hcentre : IsDirectionalCentre S .x C) (hR : R ∈ S)
    (hne : R ≠ C) (hx : 0 < R.x) :
    R.x = C.x + 1 ∧ R.y ≤ C.y ∧ R.z ≤ C.z

name: P23.OneTie.h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact
statement:
theorem h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    {C R : Normal a b c} (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hcentre : IsDirectionalCentre S .x C) (hR : R ∈ S)
    (hne : R ≠ C) (hx : R.x = 0) (hy : b ≤ R.y) (hz : c ≤ R.z) :
    C.x = a - 1 ∧ R.y ≤ C.y + b ∧ R.z ≤ C.z + c

name: P23.OneTie.h4_y_edge_exact
statement:
theorem h4_y_edge_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b c)} {C R : Normal a b c}
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hcentre : IsDirectionalCentre S .y C)
    (hR : R ∈ S) (hne : R ≠ C) (hy : 0 < R.y) :
    R.y + (if C.x < R.x then b else 0) = C.y + 1 ∧
      R.z + (if C.x < R.x then c else 0) ≤ C.z

name: P23.OneTie.h4_z_edge_exact
statement:
theorem h4_z_edge_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b c)} {C R : Normal a b c}

    (hR : R ∈ S) (hne : R ≠ C) (hz : 0 < R.z) :
    R.z + (if C.x < R.x then c else 0) = C.z + 1 ∧
      R.y + (if C.x < R.x then b else 0) ≤ C.y

statement:
theorem mul_smul_comm' (r : k) (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    x * (r • y) = r • (x * y)

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.mul_smul_raw
statement:
theorem mul_smul_raw (r : k) (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    x * (r • y) = r • (x * y)

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.one_def
statement:
theorem one_def : (1 : MonomialArtin k S) =
    if h : (1 : Normal a b c) ∈ standardFinset S then X (k := k) S 1 h else 0

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.smul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_X (r : k) (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c)
    (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) :
    r • X (k := k) S p hp =
      .ofCoeff (Finsupp.single ⟨p, hp⟩ r)

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.smul_mul_assoc'
statement:
theorem smul_mul_assoc' (r : k) (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    (r • x) * y = r • (x * y)

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.smul_mul_raw
statement:
theorem smul_mul_raw (r : k) (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    (r • x) * y = r • (x * y)

name: P23.Artin.one_mem_standardFinset
statement:
theorem one_mem_standardFinset (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :

name: P23.Artin.one_mem_standardSet
statement:
theorem one_mem_standardSet (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :

name: P23.Artin.Omega.U_apply_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_apply_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p q : MonomialIndex S) :
    U (k := k) S p (X (k := k) S q.1 q.2) = if p = q then 1 else 0

name: P23.Artin.Omega.U_ne_zero
statement:
theorem U_ne_zero (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : MonomialIndex S) :
    U (k := k) S p ≠ 0

name: P23.Artin.Omega.X_smul_U_apply_X
statement:
theorem X_smul_U_apply_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m q s : MonomialIndex S) :
    (X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 • U (k := k) S s)
        (X (k := k) S q.1 q.2) =
      if m.1 * q.1 = s.1 then 1 else 0

name: P23.Artin.Omega.X_smul_U_eq_U
statement:
theorem X_smul_U_eq_U (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m q s : MonomialIndex S) (h : m.1 * q.1 = s.1) :
    X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 • U (k := k) S s = U (k := k) S q

name: P23.Artin.Omega.X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S) (w : MonomialIndex S) :
    X (k := k) S w.1 w.2 • U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs) = 0 ↔
      ¬ w.1 ∣ s

name: P23.Artin.Omega.rootDual_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem rootDual_span_eq_top (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    Submodule.span (MonomialArtin k S) (rootDualSet k S) = ⊤

name: P23.Artin.Omega.smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_apply (r : MonomialArtin k S) (φ : Omega k S)
    (x : MonomialArtin k S) : (r • φ) x = φ (r * x)

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_X
statement:
theorem coeffAt_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p q : MonomialIndex S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S p (X (k := k) S q.1 q.2) =
      if p = q then 1 else 0

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_X_mul
statement:
theorem coeffAt_X_mul (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m e t : MonomialIndex S) (hmet : m.1 * e.1 = t.1)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S t (X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 * v) =
      coeffAt (k := k) S e v

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffAt_apply (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : MonomialIndex S)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) : coeffAt (k := k) S p v = v.coeff p

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_mul_X
statement:
theorem coeffAt_mul_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m e t : MonomialIndex S) (hmet : e.1 * m.1 = t.1)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S t (v * X (k := k) S m.1 m.2) =

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right
statement:
theorem coeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)

    (u v : MonomialArtin k S)
    (hv0 : constantCoeff (k := k) S hS v = 0)

name: P23.Artin.constantCoeff_mul
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_mul (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (u v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    constantCoeff (k := k) S hS (u * v) =

name: P23.Artin.constantCoeff_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_one (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :

name: P23.Artin.mul_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem mul_eq_one_iff (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)

name: P23.Artin.variableGenerator_is_atom
statement:
theorem variableGenerator_is_atom (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)

name: P23.Artin.coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (l h g s : MonomialIndex S)
    (hzero : X (k := k) S l.1 l.2 • U (k := k) S s = 0)
    (hlhg : l.1 * h.1 = g.1) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S h (F (U (k := k) S s)) = 0

name: P23.Artin.coeff_transfer_of_common_quotient
statement:
theorem coeff_transfer_of_common_quotient (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (m n q e h w s t : MonomialIndex S)
    (hms : m.1 * q.1 = s.1) (hnt : n.1 * q.1 = t.1)
    (hmew : m.1 * e.1 = w.1) (hnhw : n.1 * h.1 = w.1) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S e (F (U (k := k) S s)) =
      coeffAt (k := k) S h (F (U (k := k) S t))

name: P23.Artin.coeff_transfer_of_dual_relation
statement:
theorem coeff_transfer_of_dual_relation (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (m n e h w s t : MonomialIndex S)
    (hrel : X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 • U (k := k) S s =
      X (k := k) S n.1 n.2 • U (k := k) S t)
    (hmew : m.1 * e.1 = w.1) (hnhw : n.1 * h.1 = w.1) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S e (F (U (k := k) S s)) =
      coeffAt (k := k) S h (F (U (k := k) S t))

name: P23.Artin.dual_relation_of_common_quotient
statement:
theorem dual_relation_of_common_quotient (S : Finset (Normal a b c))

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_variable_eq_zero_of_trace
statement:
theorem coeffAt_variable_eq_zero_of_trace

name: P23.OneTie.mixedPrincipalBorder_below
statement:
theorem mixedPrincipalBorder_below
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    borderFinset ({mixedCore (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v (by omega)} :
      Finset (Normal a b c)) =
      {mixedY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u,
        mixedZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v,
        mixedP (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hr,
        mixedQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr}

name: P23.OneTie.mixedPrincipalBorder_below_card
statement:
theorem mixedPrincipalBorder_below_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    (borderFinset ({mixedCore (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v (by omega)} :
      Finset (Normal a b c))).card = 4

name: P23.OneTie.mixedPrincipalBorder_last
statement:
theorem mixedPrincipalBorder_last
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)

name: P23.OneTie.mixedPrincipalBorder_last_card

name: P23.OneTie.purePrincipalBorder_below_card

statement:
theorem pure_xH_endpoint

name: P23.OneTie.borderFinset_swapYZ_card

theorem borderFinset_swapYZ_card (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :

name: P23.OneTie.card_union_singletonIf

    (condition : Prop) [Decidable condition] (m : Normal a b c)
    (hnot : condition → m ∉ s) :
    (s ∪ singletonIf condition m).card = s.card + indicator condition

name: P23.OneTie.card_union_singletonProofIf
statement:
theorem card_union_singletonProofIf (s : Finset (Normal a b c))

name: P23.OneTie.isMinimalBorder_swapYZFinset_iff
statement:
theorem isMinimalBorder_swapYZFinset_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v)
    (hr : r < a - 1) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet (mixedSoclesPQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr) ↔

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYP_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYP_iff
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v)

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYQ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYQ_iff
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v)
    (hr : r < a - 1) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet (mixedSoclesYQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr) ↔

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYZ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYZ_iff
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v)
    (hr : r < a - 1) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet (mixedSoclesYZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr) ↔
      (p.y ≤ u ∧ p.z ≤ v ∧
        (p.x ≤ r ∨ (p.y + b ≤ u ∧ p.z + c ≤ v))) ∨
      (p.x = 0 ∧ p.y ≤ u + 1 ∧ p.z = 0) ∨
      (p.x = 0 ∧ p.y = 0 ∧ p.z ≤ v + 1)

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))

name: P23.OneTie.mixedBorderPQ_card
statement:
theorem mixedBorderPQ_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :

name: P23.OneTie.pureLast_border_arithmetic
statement:
theorem pureLast_border_arithmetic
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    (¬pureLastStandardNat a b v x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then pureLastStandardNat a b v (x - 1) y z
       else if b ≤ y then pureLastStandardNat a b v (a - 1) (y - b) z
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → pureLastStandardNat a b v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → pureLastStandardNat a b v x y (z - 1))) ↔
      pureLastBorderNat b v x y z

name: P23.OneTie.borderFinset_eq_expected_of_nat
statement:
theorem borderFinset_eq_expected_of_nat {a b c : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (S G : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (Std Border : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hstd : ∀ p, p ∈ standardSet S ↔ Std p.x p.y p.z)
    (hG : ∀ m, m ∈ G ↔ Border m.x m.y m.z)
    (harith : ∀ x y z, x < a →
      ((¬Std x y z ∧
        (if 0 < x then Std (x - 1) y z
         else if b ≤ y ∧ c ≤ z then Std (a - 1) (y - b) (z - c)
         else True) ∧
        (0 < y → Std x (y - 1) z) ∧
        (0 < z → Std x y (z - 1))) ↔ Border x y z)) :
    borderFinset S = G

statement:
theorem mixed_below_lower_direct_arithmetic
    {r u v U V b c : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v)
    (hnw : ¬(b ≤ U ∧ c ≤ V))
    (ey : u + (if 0 < r then b else 0) = U + 1 ∧
      v + (if 0 < r then c else 0) ≤ V)
    (ez : V = v + 1 ∧ U ≤ u) :
    r = 0 ∧ u = b ∧ U = b - 1 ∧ V = v + 1

statement:
theorem mixed_two_below_direct
    (C P : Normal a b c) (hne : C ≠ P)

    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .x C)
    (hyP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .y P)
    (hzC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .z C)
    (hbelow : C.x < a - 1) :
    (b = 1 ∧ c = 1 ∧ C.x ≤ a - 2 ∧ 1 ≤ C.y ∧ 1 ≤ C.z ∧
      P.x = C.x + 1 ∧ P.y = C.y - 1 ∧ P.z = C.z) ∨
    (C.x = 0 ∧ C.y = b ∧ c ≤ C.z ∧
      P.x = 0 ∧ P.y = b - 1 ∧ P.z = C.z + 1)

    (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    ((¬dominantLastStandardNat u v x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then dominantLastStandardNat u v (x - 1) y z
       else if b ≤ y ∧ 0 ≤ z then
         dominantLastStandardNat u v (a - 1) (y - b) (z - 0)
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → dominantLastStandardNat u v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → dominantLastStandardNat u v x y (z - 1))) ↔
      pureDominantLastCoreBorderNat u v x y z)

theorem exists_variable_mul_mem_standardFinset_of_not_root

statement:
theorem localMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal

statement:

name: P23.Artin.mem_directSocle_iff
statement:
theorem mem_directSocle_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)

    v ∈ DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom ↔
      ∀ r ∈ augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom, r * v = 0

name: P23.Artin.mem_directSocle_iff_variables
statement:
theorem mem_directSocle_iff_variables
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    v ∈ DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom ↔
      X (k := k) S Normal.xGenerator
          ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.1) * v = 0 ∧
      X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator
          ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.1) * v = 0 ∧
      X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator
          ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1) * v = 0

name: P23.Artin.monomial_mem_roots_of_mem_directSocle
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_roots_of_mem_directSocle

statement:
theorem rootBasis_linearIndependent (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :

statement:
theorem root_X_mem_directSocle

statement:
theorem root_mul_variable_eq_zero
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    {s : Normal a b c} (hs : s ∈ S) (e : Direction) :
    X (k := k) S s (root_mem_standardFinset S hs) *
        X (k := k) S e.generator
          ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 (by
            cases e with
            | x => exact hlive.1
            | y => exact hlive.2.1
            | z => exact hlive.2.2.1)) = 0

statement:

name: P23.Artin.normalModelCongr_X
statement:
theorem normalModelCongr_X (e : Normal a b c ≃* Normal a' b' c')
    (he : ∀ p, e p ∈ standardSet T ↔ p ∈ standardSet S)
    (p : Normal a b c) (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) :
    normalModelCongr (k := k) e he (X (k := k) S p hp) =
      X (k := k) T (e p) ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet T _).mpr
        ((he p).mpr ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p).mp hp)))

name: P23.Artin.normalModelCongr_truncated
statement:
theorem normalModelCongr_truncated (e : Normal a b c ≃* Normal a' b' c')
    (he : ∀ p, e p ∈ standardSet T ↔ p ∈ standardSet S) (p : Normal a b c) :
    normalModelCongr (k := k) e he (truncatedMonomial (k := k) S p) =
      truncatedMonomial (k := k) T (e p)

statement:
theorem coeffAt_X_mul_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (S : Finset (Normal a b c))

name: P23.Artin.root_coeff_zero_of_nondvd_and_surviving_product
statement:

statement:
@[simp]
theorem PX_mul_PX (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (p q : PlainExp)

    PX (k := k) S p hp * PX (k := k) S q hq =
      if h : p + q ∈ plainStandardFinset S then PX (k := k) S (p + q) h else 0

theorem PX_ne_zero (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (p : PlainExp)

statement:
theorem basisSurvives_iff (k : Type*) [Field k]

@[simp] theorem coeff_add (x y : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :

@[simp] theorem coeff_smul (r : k) (x : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :

statement:
theorem mul_def (x y : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :

statement:

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.smul_PX
statement:

theorem smul_PX (r : k) (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (p : PlainExp)

theorem PU_apply_PX (S : Finset PlainExp) (p q : PlainMonomialIndex S) :

name: P23.Monomial.PlainOmega.PU_ne_zero

theorem PX_smul_PU_eq_PU (S : Finset PlainExp)

name: P23.Monomial.plainCoeffAt_mul_PX

theorem plainCoeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right (S : Finset PlainExp)

    (g : ↥(borderFinset S)) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S (tiePolynomial (k := k) a b c) (some g) = 0

name: P23.Presentation.relationSpaceDetector_bijective
statement:

statement:

    relationSpaceDetector (k := k) S hS hdom hlive

name: P23.Presentation.relationSpaceDetector_relationClass
statement:

    relationSpaceDetector (k := k) S hS hdom hlive (relationClass S f hf) =

name: P23.Presentation.relationSpaceDetector_surjective

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.PXall_add
statement:
theorem PXall_add (R : Finset PlainExp) (p q : PlainExp) :
    PXall (k := k) R (p+q) = PXall R p * PXall R q

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.PXall_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem PXall_zero (R : Finset PlainExp) : PXall (k := k) R 0 = 1

name: P23.Monomial.coeff_plainPolyToArtin
statement:
theorem coeff_plainPolyToArtin (k : Type*) [Field k] (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k) (q : PlainMonomialIndex R) :
    (plainPolyToArtin k R f).coeff q = f.coeff q.1

name: P23.Monomial.killed_iff_border_divisor
statement:
theorem killed_iff_border_divisor (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :

name: P23.Monomial.plainPolyToArtin_kernel
statement:
theorem plainPolyToArtin_kernel (k : Type*) [Field k] (R : Finset PlainExp) :
    RingHom.ker (plainPolyToArtin k R).toRingHom =
      plainMonomialIdeal k (plainBorderFinset R)

name: P23.Monomial.plainPolyToArtin_monomial
statement:
theorem plainPolyToArtin_monomial (k : Type*) [Field k] (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (p : PlainExp) (r : k) :
    plainPolyToArtin k R (MvPolynomial.monomial p r) =
      r • PlainMonomialArtin.PXall (k := k) R p

name: P23.Monomial.plainPolyToArtin_surjective
statement:
theorem plainPolyToArtin_surjective (k : Type*) [Field k] (R : Finset PlainExp) :

theorem plainVariablesSurvive_iff_nonzero (R : Finset PlainExp) :

      ∀ j, PlainMonomialArtin.PXall (k := k) R (plainUnitVector j) ≠ 0

name: P23.Monomial.plain_PXall_nonzero_iff
statement:
theorem plain_PXall_nonzero_iff (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    PlainMonomialArtin.PXall (k := k) R p ≠ 0 ↔ p ∈ plainStandardSet R

name: P23.Monomial.plainRootTraceValue_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem plainRootTraceValue_constantCoeff_eq_zero (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : PlainRootAntichain S)
    (F : PlainOmega k S →ₗ[PlainMonomialArtin k S] PlainMonomialArtin k S)
    (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ S) :
    plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS
        (F (PU (k := k) S (plainRootIndex S s hs))) = 0

theorem plainTrace_eq_span_plainTraceValueSet (S : Finset PlainExp) :

theorem plainTrace_eq_span_rootTraceValueSet (S : Finset PlainExp) :

name: P23.Monomial.plainTrace_range_le
statement:
theorem plainTrace_range_le (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (F : PlainOmega k S →ₗ[PlainMonomialArtin k S] PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    F.range ≤ PlainTraceSubmodule k S

name: P23.Monomial.plain_exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace
statement:
theorem plain_exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace
    (S : Finset PlainExp) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : PlainRootAntichain S)
    (e : Fin 3)
    (heS : plainUnitVector e ∈ plainStandardFinset S)
    (htrace : PX (k := k) S (plainUnitVector e) heS ∈ PlainTraceSubmodule k S) :
    ∃ (F : PlainOmega k S →ₗ[PlainMonomialArtin k S] PlainMonomialArtin k S)
      (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ S),
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩
        (F (PU (k := k) S (plainRootIndex S s hs))) ≠ 0

name: P23.Monomial.plain_variable_coeff_eq_zero_of_trace
statement:
theorem plain_variable_coeff_eq_zero_of_trace
    (S : Finset PlainExp) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : PlainRootAntichain S)
    (e : Fin 3)
    (heS : plainUnitVector e ∈ plainStandardFinset S)
    (hroot : ∀ (F : PlainOmega k S →ₗ[PlainMonomialArtin k S] PlainMonomialArtin k S)
      (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ S),
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩
        (F (PU (k := k) S (plainRootIndex S s hs))) = 0)
    (t : PlainMonomialArtin k S) (ht : t ∈ PlainTraceSubmodule k S) :
    plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩ t = 0

statement:

name: P23.Monomial.plainDominantAxis_border_card
statement:
theorem plainDominantAxis_border_card (r u v : ℕ) (hr : 0<r) (hu : 0<u) (hv : 0<v) :

name: P23.Monomial.plainDominantAxis_standard
statement:
theorem plainDominantAxis_standard (r u v : ℕ) (p : PlainExp) :
    p ∈ plainStandardSet (plainDominantAxisRoots r u v) ↔
      (p 0≤r ∧ p 1≤u ∧ p 2≤v) ∨
      (p 0≤r+1 ∧ p 1=0 ∧ p 2=0) ∨ (p 0=0 ∧ p 1≤u+1 ∧ p 2=0)

name: P23.Monomial.plainExp_eq_coordinates
statement:
theorem plainExp_eq_coordinates (p : PlainExp) (x y z : ℕ) :

name: P23.Monomial.plainPlaneAxis_border_exact
statement:

name: P23.Monomial.plainPlaneAxis_standard
statement:
theorem plainPlaneAxis_standard (r u s v h : ℕ) (hru : r<u) (hsv : s<v) (p : PlainExp) :
    p ∈ plainStandardSet (plainPlaneAxisRoots r u s v h) ↔
      (p 2 = 0 ∧ p 0 ≤ u ∧ p 1 ≤ v ∧ (p 0 ≤ r ∨ p 1 ≤ s)) ∨
      (p 0 = 0 ∧ p 1 = 0 ∧ p 2 ≤ h)

name: P23.Monomial.plainTriangle_border_card
statement:
theorem plainTriangle_border_card (r u v : ℕ) :

name: P23.Monomial.plainTriangle_border_exact

statement:

    (hC : IsAperyReflectionCenter D i C) (p : D.AperyIndex i) :
    reflectionCanonicalHom (k := k) D i C hC (AU (k := k) D i p) =

name: P23.Semigroup.reflectionCanonicalHom_AU_pf_eq_tailVariableA
statement:
theorem reflectionCanonicalHom_AU_pf_eq_tailVariableA (j : Fin 3)
    (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex)
    (hf : NGWitnessForGenerator D (D.tailIndex i j) f) :
    let C := tailReflectionCenter D i j f
    let hC := tail_ngWitness_reflectionCenter D i j f hf
    reflectionCanonicalHom (k := k) D i C hC
        (AU (k := k) D i ((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i) f).1) =
      tailVariableA (k := k) D i j
